metadata.purpose: Compute-only procurement inputs for custom CNC controller architecture comparison; not an approved manufacturing BOM
metadata.method: Manufacturer specifications and seller product pages, cross-checked against live public Shopify product JSON for exact variant price, SKU, availability and quantity_price_breaks
metadata.price_scope: Public merchandise prices before shipping, tax, tariff, currency conversion, assembly and test
metadata.volume_rule: No published quantity discount or explicit volume quotation was found for selected compute variants or listed accessories. Quantity 10/100/1000 entries are null and require quotation. Do not present the quantity-one price as an actual volume quote.
metadata.availability_rule: available:true indicates the seller allows the variant to be purchased. Exact stock counts and delivery schedules at 10/100/1000 units were not established.
metadata.selection_rule: Two cost candidates only. Selection does not establish PREEMPT_RT, LinuxCNC, HostMot2, GPU, browser UI, environmental or lifetime suitability.
metadata.protected_scope: This compute comparison does not reduce the six-joint protected machine I/O or the 21.5-inch FHD capacitive touch display requirement. Neither is included in these compute prices.

candidates.name: Radxa CM3 SODIMM
candidates.availability: Exact variant available:true in live product JSON; seller HTML SKU table says Add to cart. No stock count supplied.
included: RK3566 quad-core Arm Cortex-A55 processor; seller specifies up to 1.6 GHz
SPI3_M0 accessible on SODIMM pins 27 CS0, 29 MISO, 33 MOSI, 35 CLK; HDMI also on SODIMM pins
Gigabit Ethernet MAC signals; Ethernet PHY is not included
200-pin SODIMM edge connector and additional 100-pin board-to-board interface
missing: Custom carrier PCB, SODIMM socket AND extra J1 100-pin board-to-board mate are required to use Ethernet GMAC1_M0; verify exact connector part and revision
Ethernet PHY, its supplies/clock/passives, magnetics and RJ45 connector
HDMI connector/protection, USB connectors/protection and touch USB connection
System input power conversion and protection
WiFi/Bluetooth; selected module is explicitly the non-wireless variant
Qualified cooling, enclosure mounting and any thermal interface material
FPGA, motion interface, ESP helper and machine I/O

costed_accessories.name: CM3 passive CPU heatsink, 14 x 14 x 6 mm, conductive tape included
costed_accessories.qualification: Seller names CM3, not specifically CM3 SODIMM. Physical clearance and thermal sufficiency on CM3S remain unverified; reference cost only, not a qualified cooling solution.

qualification: Cost candidate for a custom carrier, not a ready-to-wire standalone board
Manufacturer schematic confirms HDMI, SPI and GMAC connector paths; carrier PHY and connector costs must not be silently omitted

V1.5 schematic page 19 confirms SPI3_M0 on SODIMM; page 20 places GMAC1_M0 on J1. Do not remux the SODIMM SPI3 pins into GMAC1_M1 if SPI is needed simultaneously. Actual pinmux and driver must still be proven.
Public CM3S hardware schematic is revision 1.5, January 2023; actual delivered revision and support lifetime require confirmation
A supported Linux image is not evidence of PREEMPT_RT timing qualification
Raspberry Pi-specific hm2_spix support does not automatically apply to RK3566; SPI host driver/LLIO and complete FPGA protocol compatibility must be established
Must measure real-time latency while HDMI, USB touch, browser 3D, storage, network and thermal load are active
16GB sufficiency depends on OS, update/rollback policy and model storage limits

candidates.name: Radxa ROCK 3C
candidates.configuration: 2GB RAM, no storage bundled; current seller listing advertises WiFi 6 / Bluetooth 5.4
candidates.availability: Exact 2GB variant available:true in live JSON; seller page says In stock. No stock count supplied.
included: RK3566 quad-core Cortex-A55 processor up to 1.6 GHz
Full-size HDMI, specified up to 1920 x 1080 at 60 Hz
Gigabit Ethernet PHY, magnetics and RJ45 on the SBC
40-pin GPIO header with SPI3_MOSI_M1 on pin 19, MISO on 21, clock on 23 and chip selects on 24/26
USB ports for capacitive touchscreen and other peripherals
USB-C power input, microSD slot and optional eMMC module connector
Current listing advertises onboard WiFi 6 / Bluetooth 5.4; board revision and exact wireless hardware must be fixed in the procurement specification
missing: OS storage: a separately costed microSD card is listed below
Power supply or integration into system 5V supply; manufacturer recommends 5V/3A without SSD
Cooling: separately costed AE007 heatsink/fan below
HDMI, USB touch, Ethernet and power cables as required by enclosure layout
Mounting and protected SPI connection to custom FPGA/I/O board
FPGA, ESP helper and protected machine I/O

costed_accessories.name: ALLNET 64GB microSDXC UHS-1 Memory Card
costed_accessories.qualification: Current in-stock seller reference. Exact card controller/NAND, endurance, boot reliability and power-loss behavior are unqualified. Cheaper Arace Lexar 32GB $4.99 listing is sold out and was not used.

costed_accessories.name: Radxa AE007 / Heatsink 2513, heatsink with fan
costed_accessories.qualification: Seller calls this Heatsink for Rock5 Model A, but SKU AE007 matches Heatsink 2513. Radxa's Heatsink 2513 manufacturer page explicitly lists ROCK 3C under Works with. Thermal performance in the intended enclosure remains untested.

qualification: Preferred cost candidate for early hardware/software validation because Ethernet, HDMI, USB and power support circuitry are already assembled
No claim of PREEMPT_RT/LinuxCNC/HostMot2 readiness or tested browser 3D performance
Raspberry Pi-specific hm2_spix backend is not a Rockchip backend; a supported low-level SPI route must be proven
Confirm GPIO pin mux, clock, latency and electrical levels before FPGA interface design
Qualify exact WiFi hardware revision and firmware; older ROCK 3C boards use WiFi 5 / Bluetooth 5
Run worst-case timing and thermal testing with the complete 21.5-inch FHD UI workload
The microSD is a consumer storage reference; production endurance and loss-of-power behavior require testing

screened_alternatives.name: Radxa CM3 B2B module
screened_alternatives.reason_not_selected: 2GB/16GB/no-WiFi RM116-D2E16W0 is $46 but sold out. In-stock 2GB/no-eMMC RM116-D2E0W0 is $48.99 and needs separately sourced OS storage. It includes Ethernet PHY, so it remains a useful alternate if total carrier cost offsets the storage difference.

screened_alternatives.name: Radxa ZERO 3E 2GB
screened_alternatives.reason_not_selected: Available 2GB RS109-D2E0H1 is $39.99 at Arace, with GbE and micro-HDMI but no onboard WiFi; needs microSD. ROCK 3C costs $4.91 more but provides WiFi/Bluetooth, full-size HDMI and more directly usable USB ports, avoiding adapters for the integrated display product.

screened_alternatives.name: Luckfox Core3566 Lite 2GB
screened_alternatives.reason_not_selected: Official current starting price is $77.99 without eMMC or WiFi, making it less attractive than the selected Radxa module for this costing exercise.
